members.weightExplainer: A weight splits things in proportion — a share of 2 is twice a share of 1. It is only used when an expense is split by shares.
members.departedSubtitle: Left. Their past expenses and any balance still count.
members.departedNote: Leaving does not erase a debt. Someone who has left still appears in the balances until they are square, and can still be paid.
